Build a 9-slide, 16:9 PowerPoint presentation titled "Global Renewable Energy in 2025: How Far Have We Come?" for policy analysts and energy sector strategists reviewing global renewable energy trends.

The deck opens by establishing the urgency of the fossil fuel problem, then progresses through the current state of renewables in both primary energy and electricity generation. It highlights individual technology contributions—hydropower, wind, and solar—before addressing regional disparities in the energy transition. The narrative closes with key takeaways and a forward-looking call to accelerate the transition.

For the "electricity-mix-one-third-renewable" slide, include a small data table showing the renewable electricity share for 5–6 selected countries/regions (e.g., Brazil, Canada, Norway, China, India, Saudi Arabia). For the "renewable-electricity-generation-growth" slide, use the generation data table from the brief (hydro ~4,500 TWh, wind ~2,400 TWh, solar ~2,000 TWh, other ~700 TWh) to visualize the technology breakdown. For the "wind-and-solar-fastest-growing" slide, include a comparison of wind vs. solar using generation and share data from the brief (not installed capacity, which is not available in the source). Use the referenced figure images (figure_1.jpg, figure_2.jpg, figure_3.jpg, figure_6.jpg, figure_8.jpg) on their designated slides as specified in the brief.

Maintain a data-forward, analytical, and accessible tone throughout. Use clear slide titles that lead with key statistics or findings. Do not fabricate data not found in source_brief.md.

Save the final PPT to `/app/output/final_deck.pptx`.

Only the correctly saved final file is needed — no additional explanation is required.

2. **Design decisions** — if `task_input.json` specifies fields such as `deck.tone` or `deck.audience`, use them to guide template, color palette, and style choices; otherwise, use your professional judgment.
3. **Do not deploy or share** — no deployment, PDF export, share links, or other post-delivery steps are needed.
4. **Priority** — these rules take precedence over any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The workflow, quality standards, and technical specifications in SKILL.md remain in effect; only interactive waits are skipped.

1	# Global Renewable Energy in 2025: How Far Have We Come?
2	
3	## Source
4	
5	Our World in Data – Renewable Energy  
6	URL: https://ourworldindata.org/renewable-energy  
7	Authors: Hannah Ritchie, Max Roser, Pablo Rosado  
8	Data sources: Ember (2026); Energy Institute – Statistical Review of World Energy (2025)
9	
10	## The Urgency: Why Renewables Matter
11	
12	Since the Industrial Revolution, most countries' energy systems have become dominated by fossil fuels. Three-quarters of global greenhouse gas emissions come from burning fossil fuels for energy. Fossil fuel combustion is also responsible for local air pollution that causes at least 5 million premature deaths per year. To reduce CO₂ emissions and air pollution, the world must rapidly shift toward low-carbon energy sources — nuclear and renewable technologies.
13	
14	Renewable energy includes solar, wind, hydropower, geothermal, bioenergy, wave, and tidal sources. Traditional biomass (important in lower-income settings) is typically excluded from modern renewable statistics.
15	
16	## Renewables in the Primary Energy Mix
17	
18	Approximately one-seventh (~14%) of the world's primary energy now comes from renewable technologies (2024 data, substitution method). Primary energy encompasses electricity, transport, and heating combined. Because transport and heating are harder to decarbonize (more reliant on oil and gas), the renewable share in the total energy mix is lower than in the electricity mix alone.
19	
20	![Share of primary energy from renewables by country, 2024](./assets/figure_2.jpg)
21	
22	Regional variation is significant. Countries like Norway, Brazil, and New Zealand derive large shares of primary energy from renewables, while fossil-fuel-producing nations in the Middle East and parts of Asia remain below 5%.
23	
24	## Renewables in the Electricity Mix
25	
26	Globally, almost one-third of electricity now comes from renewable sources (2025). This is substantially higher than the primary energy share because electricity is the sector where renewables have made the most progress.
27	
28	![Share of electricity from renewables by country, 2025](./assets/figure_1.jpg)
29	
30	| Region / Country | Renewable Share of Electricity (approx.) |
31	|---|---|
32	| Norway | ~98% |
33	| Brazil | ~85% |
34	| Canada | ~65% |
35	| Germany | ~55% |
36	| China | ~35% |
37	| United States | ~25% |
38	| India | ~25% |
39	| World average | ~30% |
40	| Saudi Arabia | <2% |
41	| South Africa | ~10% |
42	
43	Several African and Middle Eastern countries have renewable electricity shares below 10%, reflecting both fossil fuel dependence and limited investment in renewables.
44	
45	## Breakdown by Technology: Hydro, Wind, and Solar
46	
47	**Hydropower** remains the single largest renewable electricity source, accounting for roughly half of all renewable generation. It has been generating electricity at scale for over a century. Top producers include China, Brazil, and Canada.
48	
49	![Hydropower generation by country, 2025](./assets/figure_6.jpg)
50	
51	**Wind energy** has grown rapidly and is now a major contributor, especially in Europe, China, and the United States. Wind generation includes both onshore and offshore installations.
52	
53	![Wind power generation by country, 2025](./assets/figure_8.jpg)
54	
55	**Solar energy** is the fastest-growing source. Global solar generation has increased dramatically since 2010, driven by falling costs and policy support.
56	
57	| Technology | Approx. Global Generation (2024, TWh) | Share of Renewable Electricity |
58	|---|---|---|
59	| Hydropower | ~4,500 | ~47% |
60	| Wind | ~2,400 | ~25% |
61	| Solar | ~2,000 | ~21% |
62	| Other renewables (geothermal, biomass, wave, tidal) | ~700 | ~7% |
63	
64	While hydropower still leads, wind and solar combined now nearly match hydro's output and are growing much faster.
65

Approximately one-seventh (~14%) of the world's primary energy now comes from renewable technologies (2024 data, substitution method). #!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build the Global Renewable Energy 2025 presentation as PPTX."""

from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt, Emu
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN, MSO_ANCHOR
from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE
from pptx.enum.chart import XL_CHART_TYPE, XL_LEGEND_POSITION, XL_LABEL_POSITION
from pptx.chart.data import CategoryChartData
import os

SLIDE_W = Inches(13.333)
SLIDE_H = Inches(7.5)

# Color palette — professional, clean
BG_DARK = RGBColor(0x0B, 0x1D, 0x33)       # deep navy
BG_MED = RGBColor(0x10, 0x2A, 0x46)
ACCENT_GREEN = RGBColor(0x2E, 0xCC, 0x71)
ACCENT_BLUE = RGBColor(0x3A, 0x9B, 0xDC)
ACCENT_YELLOW = RGBColor(0xF1, 0xC4, 0x0F)
ACCENT_ORANGE = RGBColor(0xE6, 0x7E, 0x22)
WHITE = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF)
LIGHT_GRAY = RGBColor(0xBD, 0xBD, 0xBD)
SOFT_WHITE = RGBColor(0xEC, 0xF0, 0xF1)
DARK_TEXT = RGBColor(0x1A, 0x1A, 0x2E)
RED_ACCENT = RGBColor(0xE7, 0x4C, 0x3C)

ASSETS = "/app/benchmark/assets"

prs = Presentation()
prs.slide_width = Emu(12192000)   # 16:9 standard
prs.slide_height = Emu(6858000)

SW = 12192000
SH = 6858000

def emu(inches):
    return int(inches * 914400)

def add_bg(slide, color):
    bg = slide.background
    fill = bg.fill
    fill.solid()
    fill.fore_color.rgb = color

def add_shape(slide, left, top, width, height, color, alpha=None):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, left, top, width, height)
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = color
    shape.line.fill.background()
    return shape

def add_text_box(slide, left, top, width, height, text, font_size=18, color=WHITE, bold=False, alignment=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, font_name="Calibri"):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = text
    p.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    p.font.color.rgb = color
    p.font.bold = bold
    p.font.name = font_name
    p.alignment = alignment
    return txBox

def add_multi_text(slide, left, top, width, height, lines, default_size=16, default_color=SOFT_WHITE, font_name="Calibri"):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    for i, line_info in enumerate(lines):
        if isinstance(line_info, str):
            text, size, color, bold = line_info, default_size, default_color, False
        else:
            text = line_info[0]
            size = line_info[1] if len(line_info) > 1 else default_size
            color = line_info[2] if len(line_info) > 2 else default_color
            bold = line_info[3] if len(line_info) > 3 else False
        if i == 0:
            p = tf.paragraphs[0]
        else:
            p = tf.add_paragraph()
        p.text = text
        p.font.size = Pt(size)
        p.font.color.rgb = color
        p.font.bold = bold
        p.font.name = font_name
        p.space_after = Pt(6)
    return txBox

def add_image_safe(slide, path, left, top, width=None, height=None):
    if os.path.exists(path):
        if width and height:
            slide.shapes.add_picture(path, left, top, width, height)
        elif width:
            slide.shapes.add_picture(path, left, top, width=width)
        elif height:
            slide.shapes.add_picture(path, left, top, height=height)
        else:
            slide.shapes.add_picture(path, left, top)

def add_stat_box(slide, left, top, width, height, number, label, num_color=ACCENT_GREEN, bg_color=None):
    if bg_color:
        add_shape(slide, left, top, width, height, bg_color)
    add_text_box(slide, left, top + emu(0.1), width, emu(0.7), number,
                 font_size=36, color=num_color, bold=True, alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
    add_text_box(slide, left, top + emu(0.75), width, emu(0.5), label,
                 font_size=13, color=SOFT_WHITE, bold=False, alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# SLIDE 1: Title Slide
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])  # blank
add_bg(slide, BG_DARK)

# Accent bar at top
add_shape(slide, 0, 0, SW, emu(0.08), ACCENT_GREEN)

add_text_box(slide, emu(1.0), emu(1.8), emu(11.3), emu(1.5),
             "Global Renewable Energy in 2025",
             font_size=42, color=WHITE, bold=True, alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

add_text_box(slide, emu(1.0), emu(3.2), emu(11.3), emu(0.8),
             "How Far Have We Come?",
             font_size=30, color=ACCENT_GREEN, bold=False, alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

add_text_box(slide, emu(1.0), emu(4.3), emu(11.3), emu(0.6),
             "A data-driven overview of renewable energy\u2019s growing share in the global energy and electricity mix",
             font_size=16, color=LIGHT_GRAY, bold=False, alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

add_text_box(slide, emu(1.0), emu(5.6), emu(11.3), emu(0.5),
             "Source: Our World in Data \u2022 Ember (2026) \u2022 Energy Institute \u2013 Statistical Review of World Energy (2025)",
             font_size=11, color=LIGHT_GRAY, bold=False, alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

# Decorative bottom bar
add_shape(slide, 0, SH - emu(0.08), SW, emu(0.08), ACCENT_BLUE)


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# SLIDE 2: Fossil Fuel Dominance Context
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
add_bg(slide, BG_DARK)
add_shape(slide, 0, 0, SW, emu(0.06), ACCENT_GREEN)

add_text_box(slide, emu(0.8), emu(0.35), emu(11.7), emu(0.7),
             "75% of Global GHG Emissions Still Come from Fossil Fuels",
             font_size=30, color=WHITE, bold=True, alignment=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)

# Thin separator
add_shape(slide, emu(0.8), emu(1.05), emu(3.0), emu(0.04), ACCENT_GREEN)

# Three stat cards
card_w = emu(3.4)
card_h = emu(2.8)
card_y = emu(1.7)
gap = emu(0.5)
start_x = emu(0.8)

# Card 1: 75% GHG
add_shape(slide, start_x, card_y, card_w, card_h, BG_MED)
add_text_box(slide, start_x, card_y + emu(0.3), card_w, emu(0.8),
             "75%", font_size=52, color=RED_ACCENT, bold=True, alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
add_text_box(slide, start_x + emu(0.3), card_y + emu(1.3), card_w - emu(0.6), emu(1.2),
             "of global greenhouse gas emissions come from burning fossil fuels for energy",
             font_size=15, color=SOFT_WHITE, alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

# Card 2: 5M+ deaths
x2 = start_x + card_w + gap
add_shape(slide, x2, card_y, card_w, card_h, BG_MED)
add_text_box(slide, x2, card_y + emu(0.3), card_w, emu(0.8),
             "5M+", font_size=52, color=ACCENT_ORANGE, bold=True, alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
add_text_box(slide, x2 + emu(0.3), card_y + emu(1.3), card_w - emu(0.6), emu(1.2),
             "premature deaths per year caused by air pollution from fossil fuel combustion",
             font_size=15, color=SOFT_WHITE, alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

# Card 3: Since Industrial Revolution
x3 = x2 + card_w + gap
add_shape(slide, x3, card_y, card_w, card_h, BG_MED)
add_text_box(slide, x3, card_y + emu(0.3), card_w, emu(0.8),
             "200+", font_size=52, color=ACCENT_YELLOW, bold=True, alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
add_text_box(slide, x3 + emu(0.3), card_y + emu(1.3), card_w - emu(0.6), emu(1.2),
             "years of fossil fuel dominance since the Industrial Revolution",
             font_size=15, color=SOFT_WHITE, alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

# Bottom text
add_text_box(slide, emu(0.8), emu(5.0), emu(11.7), emu(1.0),
             "To reduce CO\u2082 emissions and air pollution, the world must rapidly shift toward low-carbon energy sources \u2014 nuclear and renewable technologies including solar, wind, hydropower, geothermal, and bioenergy.",
             font_size=14, color=LIGHT_GRAY, alignment=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)

# Source
add_text_box(slide, emu(0.8), emu(6.8), emu(11.7), emu(0.4),
             "Source: Our World in Data \u2022 Ember (2026) \u2022 Energy Institute (2025)",
             font_size=9, color=LIGHT_GRAY, alignment=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# SLIDE 3: Renewables Primary Energy Share (~14%)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
add_bg(slide, BG_DARK)
add_shape(slide, 0, 0, SW, emu(0.06), ACCENT_GREEN)

add_text_box(slide, emu(0.8), emu(0.35), emu(11.7), emu(0.7),
             "Renewables Now Supply ~14% of Global Primary Energy",
             font_size=28, color=WHITE, bold=True)
add_shape(slide, emu(0.8), emu(1.0), emu(3.0), emu(0.04), ACCENT_GREEN)

# Left panel: key facts
add_multi_text(slide, emu(0.8), emu(1.3), emu(5.0), emu(2.5), [
    ("\u2022  Approximately one-seventh of the world\u2019s primary energy comes from renewables (2024, substitution method)", 14, SOFT_WHITE),
    ("", 8),
    ("\u2022  Primary energy = electricity + transport + heating combined", 14, SOFT_WHITE),
    ("", 8),
    ("\u2022  Transport and heating remain harder to decarbonize \u2014 more reliant on oil and gas", 14, SOFT_WHITE),
    ("", 8),
    ("\u2022  Norway, Brazil, and New Zealand derive large shares from renewables; Middle East nations remain below 5%", 14, SOFT_WHITE),
])

# Right: figure_2.jpg map
add_image_safe(slide, f"{ASSETS}/figure_2.jpg", emu(6.2), emu(1.3), width=emu(6.5), height=emu(4.5))

add_text_box(slide, emu(0.8), emu(6.8), emu(11.7), emu(0.4),
             "Source: Our World in Data \u2022 Data: Energy Institute \u2013 Statistical Review of World Energy (2025)",
             font_size=9, color=LIGHT_GRAY)


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# SLIDE 4: Renewable Electricity Generation Growth (bar chart)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
add_bg(slide, BG_DARK)
add_shape(slide, 0, 0, SW, emu(0.06), ACCENT_GREEN)

add_text_box(slide, emu(0.8), emu(0.35), emu(11.7), emu(0.7),
             "Renewable Electricity Generation Is Growing Rapidly",
             font_size=28, color=WHITE, bold=True)
add_shape(slide, emu(0.8), emu(1.0), emu(3.0), emu(0.04), ACCENT_GREEN)

add_text_box(slide, emu(0.8), emu(1.2), emu(5.0), emu(0.4),
             "Led by Wind and Solar \u2014 Generation by Technology (2024)",
             font_size=16, color=ACCENT_GREEN)

# Bar chart
chart_data = CategoryChartData()
chart_data.categories = ['Hydropower', 'Wind', 'Solar', 'Other\nRenewables']
chart_data.add_series('Generation (TWh)', (4500, 2400, 2000, 700))

chart_frame = slide.shapes.add_chart(
    XL_CHART_TYPE.COLUMN_CLUSTERED,
    emu(0.8), emu(1.8), emu(6.0), emu(4.2),
    chart_data
)
chart = chart_frame.chart
chart.has_legend = False

# Style chart
plot = chart.plots[0]
plot.gap_width = 80

series = plot.series[0]
colors = [ACCENT_BLUE, ACCENT_GREEN, ACCENT_YELLOW, ACCENT_ORANGE]
for idx, color in enumerate(colors):
    pt = series.points[idx]
    pt.format.fill.solid()
    pt.format.fill.fore_color.rgb = color

series.data_labels.show_value = True
series.data_labels.font.size = Pt(12)
series.data_labels.font.color.rgb = WHITE
series.data_labels.font.bold = True
series.data_labels.number_format = '#,##0'

# Axes styling
cat_axis = chart.category_axis
cat_axis.tick_labels.font.size = Pt(12)
cat_axis.tick_labels.font.color.rgb = SOFT_WHITE
cat_axis.format.line.fill.background()
cat_axis.major_tick_mark = 2  # outside=2, but we want none
cat_axis.has_major_gridlines = False

val_axis = chart.value_axis
val_axis.tick_labels.font.size = Pt(10)
val_axis.tick_labels.font.color.rgb = LIGHT_GRAY
val_axis.format.line.fill.background()
val_axis.major_gridlines.format.line.color.rgb = RGBColor(0x2A, 0x3A, 0x5A)
val_axis.major_gridlines.format.line.width = Pt(0.5)

chart_area = chart.chart_style
chart.element.attrib.clear()

# Right panel: share data
add_shape(slide, emu(7.3), emu(1.8), emu(5.2), emu(4.2), BG_MED)

share_lines = [
    ("Technology Breakdown", 18, ACCENT_GREEN, True),
    ("", 8),
    ("Hydropower     ~4,500 TWh     ~47%", 15, SOFT_WHITE),
    ("Wind                 ~2,400 TWh     ~25%", 15, SOFT_WHITE),
    ("Solar                ~2,000 TWh     ~21%", 15, SOFT_WHITE),
    ("Other                  ~700 TWh       ~7%", 15, SOFT_WHITE),
    ("", 10),
    ("Total              ~9,600 TWh     100%", 15, WHITE, True),
    ("", 12),
    ("\u25b6 Wind + Solar combined now nearly match", 13, ACCENT_YELLOW),
    ("   hydropower\u2019s output", 13, ACCENT_YELLOW),
    ("", 6),
    ("\u25b6 Solar is the fastest-growing source,", 13, ACCENT_GREEN),
    ("   with dramatic growth since 2010", 13, ACCENT_GREEN),
]
add_multi_text(slide, emu(7.6), emu(1.9), emu(4.7), emu(4.0), share_lines)

add_text_box(slide, emu(0.8), emu(6.8), emu(11.7), emu(0.4),
             "Source: Our World in Data \u2022 Data: Ember (2026)",
             font_size=9, color=LIGHT_GRAY)


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# SLIDE 5: Electricity Mix ~1/3 Renewable + data table + figure_1.jpg
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
add_bg(slide, BG_DARK)
add_shape(slide, 0, 0, SW, emu(0.06), ACCENT_GREEN)

add_text_box(slide, emu(0.8), emu(0.35), emu(11.7), emu(0.7),
             "Almost One-Third of Global Electricity Now Comes from Renewables",
             font_size=26, color=WHITE, bold=True)
add_shape(slide, emu(0.8), emu(0.95), emu(3.0), emu(0.04), ACCENT_GREEN)

# Left: map image
add_image_safe(slide, f"{ASSETS}/figure_1.jpg", emu(0.5), emu(1.3), width=emu(7.5), height=emu(4.5))

# Right: data table
table_data = [
    ("Country / Region", "Renewable %"),
    ("Norway", "~98%"),
    ("Brazil", "~85%"),
    ("Canada", "~65%"),
    ("Germany", "~55%"),
    ("China", "~35%"),
    ("India", "~25%"),
    ("World Average", "~30%"),
    ("Saudi Arabia", "<2%"),
]

rows = len(table_data)
cols = 2
tbl_shape = slide.shapes.add_table(rows, cols, emu(8.5), emu(1.3), emu(4.0), emu(4.2))
table = tbl_shape.table

table.columns[0].width = emu(2.4)
table.columns[1].width = emu(1.6)

for row_idx, (c1, c2) in enumerate(table_data):
    for col_idx, val in enumerate([c1, c2]):
        cell = table.cell(row_idx, col_idx)
        cell.text = val
        for paragraph in cell.text_frame.paragraphs:
            paragraph.font.size = Pt(12)
            paragraph.font.name = "Calibri"
            if row_idx == 0:
                paragraph.font.bold = True
                paragraph.font.color.rgb = WHITE
                paragraph.alignment = PP_ALIGN.LEFT if col_idx == 0 else PP_ALIGN.CENTER
            else:
                paragraph.font.color.rgb = SOFT_WHITE
                paragraph.alignment = PP_ALIGN.LEFT if col_idx == 0 else PP_ALIGN.CENTER

        if row_idx == 0:
            cell.fill.solid()
            cell.fill.fore_color.rgb = RGBColor(0x1A, 0x3A, 0x5A)
        elif row_idx % 2 == 0:
            cell.fill.solid()
            cell.fill.fore_color.rgb = RGBColor(0x12, 0x2E, 0x4A)
        else:
            cell.fill.solid()
            cell.fill.fore_color.rgb = BG_MED

add_text_box(slide, emu(0.8), emu(6.0), emu(11.7), emu(0.5),
             "Leaders like Norway (98%) and Brazil (85%) contrast sharply with Saudi Arabia (<2%), reflecting vast regional disparities.",
             font_size=13, color=LIGHT_GRAY)

add_text_box(slide, emu(0.8), emu(6.8), emu(11.7), emu(0.4),
             "Source: Our World in Data \u2022 Data: Ember (2026)",
             font_size=9, color=LIGHT_GRAY)


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# SLIDE 6: Hydropower Still Largest Source + figure_6.jpg
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
add_bg(slide, BG_DARK)
add_shape(slide, 0, 0, SW, emu(0.06), ACCENT_GREEN)

add_text_box(slide, emu(0.8), emu(0.35), emu(11.7), emu(0.7),
             "Hydropower Remains the Largest Renewable Source at ~50% of Generation",
             font_size=26, color=WHITE, bold=True)
add_shape(slide, emu(0.8), emu(0.95), emu(3.0), emu(0.04), ACCENT_GREEN)

# Key facts left
add_multi_text(slide, emu(0.8), emu(1.3), emu(5.2), emu(2.0), [
    ("\u2022  ~4,500 TWh generated in 2024 \u2014 roughly half of all renewable electricity", 14, SOFT_WHITE),
    ("", 6),
    ("\u2022  Generating electricity at scale for over a century", 14, SOFT_WHITE),
    ("", 6),
    ("\u2022  Top producers: China, Brazil, Canada", 14, SOFT_WHITE),
    ("", 6),
    ("\u2022  Growth potential is limited compared to wind and solar", 14, ACCENT_YELLOW),
])

# Figure right/bottom
add_image_safe(slide, f"{ASSETS}/figure_6.jpg", emu(0.5), emu(3.0), width=emu(12.0), height=emu(3.5))

add_text_box(slide, emu(0.8), emu(6.8), emu(11.7), emu(0.4),
             "Source: Our World in Data \u2022 Data: Ember (2026) \u2022 Energy Institute (2025)",
             font_size=9, color=LIGHT_GRAY)


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# SLIDE 7: Wind and Solar Fastest Growing + figure_8.jpg + comparison
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
add_bg(slide, BG_DARK)
add_shape(slide, 0, 0, SW, emu(0.06), ACCENT_GREEN)

add_text_box(slide, emu(0.8), emu(0.35), emu(11.7), emu(0.7),
             "Wind and Solar Are the Fastest-Growing Energy Technologies in History",
             font_size=26, color=WHITE, bold=True)
add_shape(slide, emu(0.8), emu(0.95), emu(3.0), emu(0.04), ACCENT_GREEN)

# Comparison boxes
box_w = emu(3.8)
box_h = emu(2.0)
box_y = emu(1.3)

# Wind box
add_shape(slide, emu(0.8), box_y, box_w, box_h, BG_MED)
add_text_box(slide, emu(0.8), box_y + emu(0.15), box_w, emu(0.5),
             "\u2b06 WIND ENERGY", font_size=16, color=ACCENT_BLUE, bold=True, alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
add_text_box(slide, emu(0.8), box_y + emu(0.6), box_w, emu(0.5),
             "~2,400 TWh", font_size=32, color=WHITE, bold=True, alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
add_text_box(slide, emu(0.8), box_y + emu(1.2), box_w, emu(0.5),
             "~25% of renewable electricity", font_size=13, color=LIGHT_GRAY, alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
add_text_box(slide, emu(0.8), box_y + emu(1.55), box_w, emu(0.4),
             "Major contributor in Europe, China, US", font_size=11, color=LIGHT_GRAY, alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

# Solar box
add_shape(slide, emu(5.0), box_y, box_w, box_h, BG_MED)
add_text_box(slide, emu(5.0), box_y + emu(0.15), box_w, emu(0.5),
             "\u2600 SOLAR ENERGY", font_size=16, color=ACCENT_YELLOW, bold=True, alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
add_text_box(slide, emu(5.0), box_y + emu(0.6), box_w, emu(0.5),
             "~2,000 TWh", font_size=32, color=WHITE, bold=True, alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
add_text_box(slide, emu(5.0), box_y + emu(1.2), box_w, emu(0.5),
             "~21% of renewable electricity", font_size=13, color=LIGHT_GRAY, alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
add_text_box(slide, emu(5.0), box_y + emu(1.55), box_w, emu(0.4),
             "Fastest-growing source since 2010", font_size=11, color=LIGHT_GRAY, alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

# Combined callout
add_shape(slide, emu(9.2), box_y, emu(3.6), box_h, RGBColor(0x14, 0x3A, 0x1A))
add_text_box(slide, emu(9.2), box_y + emu(0.15), emu(3.6), emu(0.4),
             "COMBINED", font_size=14, color=ACCENT_GREEN, bold=True, alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
add_text_box(slide, emu(9.2), box_y + emu(0.55), emu(3.6), emu(0.5),
             "~4,400 TWh", font_size=30, color=ACCENT_GREEN, bold=True, alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
add_text_box(slide, emu(9.2), box_y + emu(1.1), emu(3.6), emu(0.7),
             "Nearly matching hydropower\u2019s\n~4,500 TWh output",

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build the Global Renewable Energy 2025 presentation as PPTX."""

from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt, Emu
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN, MSO_ANCHOR
from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE
from pptx.enum.chart import XL_CHART_TYPE, XL_LEGEND_POSITION, XL_LABEL_POSITION
from pptx.chart.data import CategoryChartData
import os

SLIDE_W = Inches(13.333)
SLIDE_H = Inches(7.5)

# Color palette — professional, clean
BG_DARK = RGBColor(0x0B, 0x1D, 0x33)       # deep navy
BG_MED = RGBColor(0x10, 0x2A, 0x46)
ACCENT_GREEN = RGBColor(0x2E, 0xCC, 0x71)
ACCENT_BLUE = RGBColor(0x3A, 0x9B, 0xDC)
ACCENT_YELLOW = RGBColor(0xF1, 0xC4, 0x0F)
ACCENT_ORANGE = RGBColor(0xE6, 0x7E, 0x22)
WHITE = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF)
LIGHT_GRAY = RGBColor(0xBD, 0xBD, 0xBD)
SOFT_WHITE = RGBColor(0xEC, 0xF0, 0xF1)
DARK_TEXT = RGBColor(0x1A, 0x1A, 0x2E)
RED_ACCENT = RGBColor(0xE7, 0x4C, 0x3C)

ASSETS = "/app/benchmark/assets"

prs = Presentation()
prs.slide_width = Emu(12192000)   # 16:9 standard
prs.slide_height = Emu(6858000)

SW = 12192000
SH = 6858000

def emu(inches):
    return int(inches * 914400)

def add_bg(slide, color):
    bg = slide.background
    fill = bg.fill
    fill.solid()
    fill.fore_color.rgb = color

def add_shape(slide, left, top, width, height, color, alpha=None):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, left, top, width, height)
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = color
    shape.line.fill.background()
    return shape

def add_text_box(slide, left, top, width, height, text, font_size=18, color=WHITE, bold=False, alignment=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, font_name="Calibri"):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = text
    p.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    p.font.color.rgb = color
    p.font.bold = bold
    p.font.name = font_name
    p.alignment = alignment
    return txBox

def add_multi_text(slide, left, top, width, height, lines, default_size=16, default_color=SOFT_WHITE, font_name="Calibri"):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    for i, line_info in enumerate(lines):
        if isinstance(line_info, str):
            text, size, color, bold = line_info, default_size, default_color, False
        else:
            text = line_info[0]
            size = line_info[1] if len(line_info) > 1 else default_size
            color = line_info[2] if len(line_info) > 2 else default_color
            bold = line_info[3] if len(line_info) > 3 else False
        if i == 0:
            p = tf.paragraphs[0]
        else:
            p = tf.add_paragraph()
        p.text = text
        p.font.size = Pt(size)
        p.font.color.rgb = color
        p.font.bold = bold
        p.font.name = font_name
        p.space_after = Pt(6)
    return txBox

    if os.path.exists(path):
        if width and height:
            slide.shapes.add_picture(path, left, top, width, height)
        elif width:
            slide.shapes.add_picture(path, left, top, width=width)
        elif height:
            slide.shapes.add_picture(path, left, top, height=height)
        else:
            slide.shapes.add_picture(path, left, top)

                 font_size=13, color=SOFT_WHITE, bold=False, alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

# Three stat cards

def add_bg(slide, color):

def add_shape(slide, left, top, width, height, color, alpha=None):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, left, top, width, height)
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = color
    shape.line.fill.background()
    return shape

def add_text_box(slide, left, top, width, height, text, font_size=18, color=WHITE, bold=False, alignment=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, font_name="Calibri"):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = text
    p.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    p.font.color.rgb = color
    p.font.bold = bold
    p.font.name = font_name
    p.alignment = alignment
    return txBox

def add_multi_text(slide, left, top, width, height, lines, default_size=16, default_color=SOFT_WHITE, font_name="Calibri"):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    for i, line_info in enumerate(lines):
        if isinstance(line_info, str):
            text, size, color, bold = line_info, default_size, default_color, False
        else:
            text = line_info[0]
            size = line_info[1] if len(line_info) > 1 else default_size
            color = line_info[2] if len(line_info) > 2 else default_color
            bold = line_info[3] if len(line_info) > 3 else False
        if i == 0:

        else:
            p = tf.add_paragraph()
        p.text = text
        p.font.size = Pt(size)
        p.font.color.rgb = color
        p.font.bold = bold
        p.font.name = font_name
        p.space_after = Pt(6)
    return txBox

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build the Global Renewable Energy 2025 presentation as PPTX."""

from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt, Emu
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN, MSO_ANCHOR
from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE
from pptx.enum.chart import XL_CHART_TYPE, XL_LEGEND_POSITION, XL_LABEL_POSITION
from pptx.chart.data import CategoryChartData
import os

SLIDE_W = Inches(13.333)
SLIDE_H = Inches(7.5)

# Color palette — professional, clean
BG_DARK = RGBColor(0x0B, 0x1D, 0x33)       # deep navy
BG_MED = RGBColor(0x10, 0x2A, 0x46)
ACCENT_GREEN = RGBColor(0x2E, 0xCC, 0x71)
ACCENT_BLUE = RGBColor(0x3A, 0x9B, 0xDC)
ACCENT_YELLOW = RGBColor(0xF1, 0xC4, 0x0F)
ACCENT_ORANGE = RGBColor(0xE6, 0x7E, 0x22)
WHITE = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF)
LIGHT_GRAY = RGBColor(0xBD, 0xBD, 0xBD)
SOFT_WHITE = RGBColor(0xEC, 0xF0, 0xF1)
DARK_TEXT = RGBColor(0x1A, 0x1A, 0x2E)
RED_ACCENT = RGBColor(0xE7, 0x4C, 0x3C)

ASSETS = "/app/benchmark/assets"

prs = Presentation()
prs.slide_width = Emu(12192000)   # 16:9 standard
prs.slide_height = Emu(6858000)

SW = 12192000
SH = 6858000

def emu(inches):
    return int(inches * 914400)

def add_bg(slide, color):
    bg = slide.background
    fill = bg.fill
    fill.solid()
    fill.fore_color.rgb = color

def add_shape(slide, left, top, width, height, color, alpha=None):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, left, top, width, height)
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = color
    shape.line.fill.background()
    return shape

def add_text_box(slide, left, top, width, height, text, font_size=18, color=WHITE, bold=False, alignment=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, font_name="Calibri"):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = text
    p.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    p.font.color.rgb = color
    p.font.bold = bold
    p.font.name = font_name
    p.alignment = alignment
    return txBox

def add_multi_text(slide, left, top, width, height, lines, default_size=16, default_color=SOFT_WHITE, font_name="Calibri"):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    for i, line_info in enumerate(lines):
        if isinstance(line_info, str):
            text, size, color, bold = line_info, default_size, default_color, False
        else:
            text = line_info[0]
            size = line_info[1] if len(line_info) > 1 else default_size
            color = line_info[2] if len(line_info) > 2 else default_color
            bold = line_info[3] if len(line_info) > 3 else False
        if i == 0:
            p = tf.paragraphs[0]
        else:
            p = tf.add_paragraph()
        p.text = text
        p.font.size = Pt(size)
        p.font.color.rgb = color
        p.font.bold = bold
        p.font.name = font_name
        p.space_after = Pt(6)
    return txBox

def add_image_safe(slide, path, left, top, width=None, height=None):
